_comment: Canonical passive check list. Every id below must appear in a report's check_log (status ok, or failed/skipped with a detail) unless --allow-incomplete is used.

required.name: DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT)
DKIM (common selectors)
required.method: DNS TXT lookup of a fixed list of common selectors

required.name: DNSSEC
required.method: DNS DS/DNSKEY lookups and resolver AD flag

required.name: TLS protocol versions
required.method: One openssl s_client handshake per protocol version

required.name: HTTP to HTTPS redirect
required.method: One plain-HTTP GET of / (no redirect following)

required.name: Technology fingerprint
required.method: Server / X-Powered-By headers and generator meta tag from the GET of /
